title: Pagination Techniques
description: Implement offset-based and cursor-based pagination with Prisma Client.

data.text: Pagination is essential for APIs that return large datasets. Prisma supports two main pagination strategies: offset-based and cursor-based.
Offset pagination uses `skip` and `take` to page through results. It is simple but can be slow on large tables because the database must scan and discard skipped rows.

data.title: Offset Pagination
data.content: Fetch page 2 with 10 items per page.

data.text: Cursor pagination uses a unique cursor (usually an ID or timestamp) to fetch the next page. It is more stable when data changes between requests.

data.title: Cursor Pagination
data.content: Fetch the next page after a given cursor.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use cursor pagination for infinite scroll feeds and real-time data. Use offset pagination for traditional page numbers where stability is not critical.
